name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: In Hillsbrad, the Forsaken strike at the farms that feed the human town. High Executor Darthalia orders the attack from Tarren Mill under Varimathras's command.

sections.title: Starving the Resistance
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken campaign from Tarren Mill. Varimathras in the Undercity has ordered her to break the human resistance in Hillsbrad Foothills. Before attacking the defended town, Darthalia targets its northern fields. The farms feed the town, and disrupting them cuts provisions to the human militia while bringing disorder to the homesteads.

sections.title: A Delaying Action
sections.body: The Forsaken press the human defenders while the Royal Apothecary Society works on a plague meant to destroy the living and the Scourge. Darthalia sees the fighting as a way to hold the humans down until the plague is ready. Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz are among the landowners killed in these early attacks.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking simple farmers?
faq.answer: The farmers and farmhands in Hillsbrad Fields help supply the town of Hillsbrad. Killing landowners such as Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and disrupting the farms cuts food to the human garrison and weakens its defenses before a direct assault.
High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill, orders the attack. She answers to Varimathras and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society's role in this campaign?
faq.answer: Darthalia says the fighting holds back the living while Forsaken apothecaries prepare a plague to destroy their enemies.

faq.q: Where are Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz located?
faq.answer: Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz oversee the northern Hillsbrad Fields. Farmer Ray is near the large farmhouse or in the garden just east of it. Farmer Getz is at the barn, the secondary house, or the surrounding fields.

faq.q: What happens after completing this raid?
faq.answer: After you return victorious to Darthalia, the assault moves to the southern fields and Hillsbrad. Other operations also open, including the gathering of grim trophies in Souvenirs of Death.

faq.q: Why does Darthalia threaten her soldiers?
faq.answer: Darthalia demands strict discipline and ruthlessness. She treats hesitation or levity about the war with the Alliance as treason, punishable by immediate execution.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you fight to reclaim Lordaeron by wiping out the living who claim your homeland as stolen ground.
As Horde, you see the brutality of Sylvanas's war against the Alliance in the northern campaign from Tarren Mill, even as Thrall preaches honor.
As Alliance, you face the danger to Lordaeron's remaining human enclaves in the slaughter of the northern homesteaders.
